branding.title: Branding
branding.intro: How the documents you issue look: your logo at the top, your colour for the title, and your terms at the end.
branding.profileFirst: Save your business details first: they come before the branding on every document.

logo.heading: Logo
logo.hint: A PNG or JPEG of up to {size}. It sits at the top of every document you issue from now on.
logo.tryAgain: Try again to upload the logo
logo.wrongType: Choose a PNG or JPEG image.
logo.tooLarge: Choose an image of up to {size}.
logo.uploadFailed: The logo didn't reach storage. Check your connection and try again.
logo.broken: This logo can't be shown. Upload it again as a PNG or JPEG image.
logo.removeDescription: Documents you issue from now on have no logo. Documents already issued keep theirs.

details.heading: Colour and terms
details.colourHint: For each document's title and the rule under its header. Leave it empty for the standard blue.
details.colourInvalid: Use a colour like #1f6f5c: a # and six digits or letters from a to f.
details.termsHint: Printed at the end of every document, such as how to pay and what cancelling costs.

sample.heading: Preview
sample.intro: See your branding on a sample quotation. It is numbered SMPL and kept with your documents, as every issued document is.
sample.preparing: {number} is being prepared. This takes a few seconds.
sample.failed: {number} can't be made into a PDF: its text has characters the PDF can't show yet.
sample.checkFailed: {number} was issued, but whether its PDF is ready didn't load.

list.title: Documents
list.intro: The documents your organization has issued, newest first. Each is kept as it was issued, with its PDF.
list.empty: No documents yet. Preview a sample quotation on the branding screen to issue your first.

share.title: Share {number}
share.description: Anyone with a link can open this document's PDF until the link expires or you turn it off. You're told when it's opened.
share.label: Label
share.labelHint: For you and your staff, such as who the link is for. Customers don't see it.
share.labelInvalid: Give the link a label of up to 200 characters, with letters or digits and no hidden characters.
share.onlyOnce: This is the only time the whole link is shown. Copy it now and send it to your customer.
share.opened: {count, plural, one {Opened # time} other {Opened # times}}, last {when}
share.revokeDescription: Whoever has it can no longer open the document. This can't be undone: make a new link to share it again.
